description: List CRM customers: companies that bought — a purchase order (processing, shipped, delivered or refunded, or with a settled payment) or a won deal that never became an order. Filter by health, lifetime-value bucket, owner, name search or minimum won deals; sorted by lifetime value and paginated. Returns summary rows (id, name, health, lifetimeValue = completed-order revenue plus won deals without an order, purchases = purchase orders plus won deals without an order, repeat = two or more purchases, lastPurchaseAt, wonDealsCount = every won deal, lastActivityAt, owner) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Read-only. Use get_customer to fetch one customer's detail by company id; use list_people_customers for people who bought without a company (shop buyers).

health.description: Filter by customer health. Omit for any. Allowed: healthy, at_risk, churned.

ltv.description: Filter by lifetime-value bucket. Omit for any. Allowed: lt10k, 10k50k, gt50k.

ownerId.description: Filter to customers owned by this workspace member's user id.

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of customers per page (1-100). Default 25.

q.description: Free-text search over the customer company name. Omit for no text filter.

sortDir.description: Sort direction by lifetime value. Default desc (highest first).

wonDealsMin.description: Only customers with at least this many won deals (orders are not counted here).

name: list_customers
title: List customers
